about: A feature's tries a day (AI_TRIES_PER_LIMIT in src/shared/ai.ts; the owner's answers, 2026-10-06: the picture read alone, three times its limit, and the used-up sentence when they run out). Replayed by tests/unit/ai-service.test.ts and php/tests/Ai/AiServiceTest.php on the fake provider with the ledger and the kept pictures in memory, so both services are held to one table. A day is one actor's Canary day, 2026-09-18. `limits` is each feature's own daily limit where the day sets one; every other feature has the default. `ledger` is what the ledger already holds when the day's steps begin: `times` records of that feature, each `ok` or not, for another actor or another day when it says so. A step is one call of `feature`, which the fake answers (`works`) or fails. `answer` is what the service answers: ok, or the error's key. `left` is what api/config then says is left of that feature today; every other feature's count must stand where it last stood. On an ok step the route's own `remaining` is that number too, and on ai_quota the sentence names the feature's limit. `kept` is the pictures the day's steps kept, `recorded` the ledger records they added.

days.name: failed reads are free until the tries run out, then what is left is the smaller of the two
the tries run out before any read worked: the used-up sentence, and the refused read keeps and records nothing
an ordinary day at the default limit is as it was: three failed reads, then the three reads
a failed flyer and a failed share text never count, however many: their tries have no bound
another actor's tries, another day's, another feature's and a later release's record move nothing
